verseEnglish: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
And your God is one God.

verseArabic: وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
verseEnglish: And your God is one God; there is no deity except Him.
Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One.'
Allah, the Eternal Refuge.

verseArabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
verseEnglish: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.

verseArabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
verseEnglish: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.
The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
The Sovereign of mankind.
The Sovereign, the Pure, the Source of Peace.
The Sovereign, the Pure, the Source of Peace.
The Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might.
The Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might.
Then know that Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.
Then know that Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.
Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
And Allah is Seeing of what they do.
And He is the Subtle, the Acquainted.

verseArabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ
verseEnglish: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.
And Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing.
And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
The Grand, the Exalted.
That is because Allah is the Truth.
Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
An excellent protector and an excellent helper.
You are our protector, so give us victory.

verseArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verseEnglish: Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
And Allah is Free of need and Forbearing.
And know that Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner.
He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor.
The Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner.
He is the First and the Last.
He is the First and the Last.
The Manifest and the Hidden.
The Manifest and the Hidden.
And Allah is, over all things, Witness.
Indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant.
Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive.
Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate.
Honorable Owner of the Throne.
Indeed, Allah is powerful and exalted in might.

verseArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ
verseEnglish: Indeed, it is Allah who is the Provider, possessor of strength, the Firm.
Indeed, it is Allah who is the Continual Provider.
And He is the Knowing Judge.
Indeed, You are the Bestower.
And indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents.
Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
And Allah is ever Pardoning and Forgiving.
And Allah is Kind to His servants.
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
And establish prayer and spend out of what We have provided for them.
And establish prayer and give zakah.
Then complete the fast until the sunset.
And complete the Hajj and 'umrah for Allah.
And complete the Hajj and 'umrah for Allah.
You see them bowing and prostrating.
And bow with those who bow.
And those who spend the night to their Lord prostrating and standing.
Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
Proceed to the remembrance of Allah.
The seven heavens and the earth glorify Him.
And say, 'Praise to Allah.'
And magnify Him with all magnificence.

verseArabic: فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
verseEnglish: So know that there is no deity except Allah.
Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
Repent to Allah with sincere repentance.
Being sincere to Him in religion.
They who are during their prayer humbly submissive.
So turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram.
And the places of worship are for Allah alone.
And an announcement from Allah and His Messenger.

verseArabic: إِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَاغْسِلُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ
verseEnglish: When you rise to prayer, wash your faces.

verseArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
verseEnglish: Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves.
By the dawn and by the ten nights.
And when you put aside your garments at noon.
By time, indeed mankind is in loss.
And to Allah belongs the east and the west.
And after the night prayer.

verseArabic: إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَاةِ مِن يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ
verseEnglish: When the call is proclaimed for the prayer on the day of Friday.
And by the even and the odd.

verseArabic: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ
verseEnglish: And from the night, wake for prayer as an additional devotion for you.
They recite it as it should be recited.
And recite the Quran with measured recitation.
If you disclose your charitable expenditures, they are good.

verseArabic: الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
verseEnglish: Those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah.
They who fulfill their vows and fear a Day.

verseArabic: إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا
verseEnglish: When they offered a sacrifice, and it was accepted from one of them.
And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice.
Then whatever can be obtained with ease of sacrificial animals.
And perform circumambulation of the ancient House.

verseArabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
verseEnglish: Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.
Do not kill game while you are in the state of ihram.
Then when you depart from 'Arafat.
Remember Allah at al-Mash'ar al-Haram.
Allah has made the Ka'bah, the Sacred House.
And when We made the House a place of return for the people.
And take, from the standing place of Abraham, a place of prayer.

verseArabic: بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ
verseEnglish: In an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House.
While you are secluded in the mosques.

verseArabic: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ
verseEnglish: The month of Ramadhan in which was revealed the Quran.

verseArabic: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ
verseEnglish: The month of Ramadhan in which was revealed the Quran.
Indeed, We sent the Quran down during the Night of Decree.

verseArabic: وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ
verseEnglish: And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct.
Then complete the fast until nightfall.
And take provisions, but indeed, the best provision is fear of Allah.
It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
Exalted is He who took His Servant by night.
Until Allah brings about His command.
You enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong.

verseArabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْرِ
verseEnglish: Then We put you on an ordained way by Our command.
And they firmly believe in the Hereafter.
I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
Indeed, the convulsion of the Hour is a terrible thing.

verseArabic: إِن كُنتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِّنَ الْبَعْثِ
verseEnglish: If you should be in doubt about the Resurrection.
Likewise is the resurrection.
At the first gathering.
And Allah is swift in account.
And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection.
Guide us to the straight path.

verseArabic: مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ
verseEnglish: Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission?
Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense.
A reward from Allah, and with Allah is the best reward.
And know that Allah is severe in penalty.
And for them is a great punishment.

verseArabic: أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ
verseEnglish: That they will have gardens beneath which rivers flow.
They will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging.
And fine dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence.
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure.
Then if you die - would they live forever?
Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
And its mixture is of Tasneem.
A spring therein named Salsabeel.
Fair ones reserved in pavilions.
Brothers on thrones facing each other.
And cups put in place.
And cushions lined up.
And rich carpets spread around.

verseArabic: فَاتَّقُوا النَّارَ الَّتِي وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ
verseEnglish: Then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones.
Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait.
And when Hellfire is set ablaze.
And We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
I will drive him into Saqar.
No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
His refuge will be an abyss.
Or the tree of zaqqum?
Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds.
In scorching fire and scalding water.
And he will be given a drink of purulent water.
Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains.
Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks.
And for them are maces of iron.
We will call the angels of Hell.

verseArabic: وَنَادَوْا يَا مَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ
verseEnglish: And they will call, 'O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!'
And approval from Allah.
And He will cause them to meet radiance and happiness.
And He will cause them to meet radiance and happiness.
For them are good tidings in the worldly life.
That is the great attainment.
That is the manifest loss.
And warn them of the Day of Regret.
And they will conceal remorse when they see the punishment.
And the Horn will be blown.
It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
On the Day the blast will convulse.
There will follow it the subsequent blast.
The Striking Calamity - What is the Striking Calamity?
When the Occurrence occurs.
The Inevitable Reality - What is the Inevitable Reality?
Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming Event?
When there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity.

verseArabic: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ
verseEnglish: The month of Ramadhan in which was revealed the Quran.
This is the Book about which there is no doubt.

verseArabic: مَا نَنسَخْ مِنْ آيَةٍ أَوْ نُنسِهَا نَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ مِّنْهَا
verseEnglish: We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth [one] better.
Then produce a surah like thereof.
He gives wisdom to whom He wills.
Guidance for those conscious of Allah.

verseArabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ
verseEnglish: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant.
Until there came to them clear evidence.

meaning: Revelation sent down from on high
verseEnglish: And indeed, it is a revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
It is not but a revelation revealed.

verseArabic: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا التَّوْرَاةَ فِيهَا هُدًى وَنُورٌ
verseEnglish: Indeed, We sent down the Torah, in which was guidance and light.
And We gave him the Gospel, in which was guidance and light.
And to David We gave the book of Psalms.
The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
Those who deliver the messages of Allah.
Then Allah sent the prophets as bringers of good tidings and warners.

verseArabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ
verseEnglish: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord.
But [he is] the Messenger of Allah and the seal of the prophets.
And say, 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge.'

verseArabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ
verseEnglish: I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant.
That they may obtain understanding in the religion.
Do you not reason?
Are signs for those of understanding.

verseArabic: قُلْ هَٰذِهِ سَبِيلِي أَدْعُو إِلَى اللَّهِ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ
verseEnglish: Say, 'This is my way; I invite to Allah with insight.'
There has come to you a conclusive proof from your Lord.

verseArabic: أَتُرِيدُونَ أَن تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَانًا مُّبِينًا
verseEnglish: Do you wish to give Allah against yourselves a clear warrant?
Say, 'With Allah is the far-reaching argument.'

verseArabic: ادْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ
verseEnglish: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction.
And indeed, it is a reminder for the righteous.
And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
About what are they asking one another? About the great news.
Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book.
And speak to people good words.
Then Adam received from his Lord words.
Who taught by the pen.
Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe.
In parchment unrolled.

verseArabic: إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ فِي كِتَابٍ مَّكْنُونٍ
verseEnglish: Indeed, it is a noble Quran In a Register well-protected.
In an Inscribed Tablet, Preserved.
In a Preserved Tablet.

verseArabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْآنٌ مُّبِينٌ
verseEnglish: It is not but a message and a clear Quran.
And others unspecific.

verseArabic: مِنْهُ آيَاتٌ مُّحْكَمَاتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ
verseEnglish: In it are verses that are precise - they are the foundation of the Book.
And none knows its true interpretation except Allah.
And the best explanation.

verseArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي أَن يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا
verseEnglish: Indeed, Allah is not timid to present an example.
And these examples We present to the people.
We relate to you the best of stories.

verseArabic: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِّأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
verseEnglish: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding.
Nor of those who are astray.
The right course has become clear from the wrong.
The right course has become distinct from the wrong.
Rather, [we follow] the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth.
And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham?
Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam.
Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam.

verseArabic: وَلَٰكِن قُولُوا أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْإِيمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ
verseEnglish: Rather say, 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts.
Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct.
And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty.

verseArabic: أَفِي اللَّهِ شَكٌّ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
verseEnglish: Is there doubt about Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth?

verseArabic: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فِرَاشًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً
verseEnglish: He who made for you the earth a bed and the sky a ceiling.

verseArabic: لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
verseEnglish: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.
He who made for you the earth a bed.
By the sun and its brightness.
The Hour has come near, and the moon has split.
By the star when it descends.
Indeed, I saw eleven stars and the sun and the moon.
And each, in an orbit, is swimming.
By the sky containing great stars.
By the morning brightness and by the night when it covers.
By the night when it covers.
And by the day when it appears.
So I swear by the twilight glow.
Until the darkness of the night.
And left them in darkness so they could not see.

verseArabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُزْجِي سَحَابًا
verseEnglish: Do you not see that Allah drives clouds?
And We shaded you with clouds.

verseArabic: إِن كَانَ بِكُمْ أَذًى مِّن مَّطَرٍ
verseEnglish: If you are troubled by rain.

verseArabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِن بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا
verseEnglish: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired.
And you see the rain emerge from within them.

verseArabic: وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِن جِبَالٍ فِيهَا مِن بَرَدٍ
verseEnglish: And sends down from the sky, with mountains [of clouds] within which is hail.
And the thunder exalts [Allah] with praise of Him.
The lightning almost snatches away their sight.
So the thunderbolt struck you while you were looking on.
And the directing of the winds.
Then it is struck by a whirlwind containing fire.

verseArabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ
verseEnglish: And We made from water every living thing.
And the ships which sail through the sea.
Gardens beneath which rivers flow.
So there gushed forth from it twelve springs.
And the sea will cast it upon the bank.

verseArabic: أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ
verseEnglish: That We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.

verseArabic: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ
verseEnglish: If We had sent down this Quran upon a mountain.
By the Mount and by an inscribed Book.
And the mountains as pegs?
Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust?
And began the creation of man from clay.
And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
From altered black mud.
Like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed.
Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths.
By the fig and the olive.
By the fig and the olive.

verseArabic: أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ
verseEnglish: Would one of you like to have a garden of palm trees and grapevines?
In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
Indeed, Allah is the cleaver of grain and date seeds.
And produce thereby crops.

verseArabic: فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ
verseEnglish: And brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you.

verseArabic: وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا
verseEnglish: And not a leaf falls but that He knows it.
The flower of the worldly life.

verseArabic: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِّن مَّاءٍ
verseEnglish: Allah has created every moving creature from water.

verseArabic: وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ مِمَّا ذَرَأَ مِنَ الْحَرْثِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ نَصِيبًا
verseEnglish: And they assign to Allah from that which He created of crops and livestock a share.

verseArabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
verseEnglish: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
And fine branded horses.
And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride.
And the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride.

verseArabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ
verseEnglish: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread?
And your Lord inspired the bee.

verseArabic: قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوا مَسَاكِنَكُمْ
verseEnglish: An ant said, 'O ants, enter your dwellings.'

verseArabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ كَمَثَلِ الْعَنكَبُوتِ
verseEnglish: The example of those who take allies other than Allah is like that of the spider.
Indeed, mankind is in loss.
Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.'
Say, 'I am only a man like you.'
O reassured soul.
Say, 'The soul is of the affair of my Lord.'
In their hearts is disease.
Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart.
Did We not expand for you your breast?
So wherever you [might] turn, there is the face of Allah.
Have We not made for him two eyes?
And a tongue and two lips?
And a tongue and two lips?
And the ear for the ear.
The hand of Allah is over their hands.
And your feet to the ankles.
They put their fingers in their ears.

verseArabic: بَلَىٰ قَادِرِينَ عَلَىٰ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ
verseEnglish: Yes. We are able to restore his very fingertips.

verseArabic: كُلَّمَا نَضِجَتْ جُلُودُهُم بَدَّلْنَاهُمْ جُلُودًا غَيْرَهَا
verseEnglish: Every time their skins are roasted through We will replace them with other skins.
Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
And We clothed the bones with flesh.
And shed blood?

verseArabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِيٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
verseEnglish: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
Created man from a clinging clot.
Then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed.

verseArabic: وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ
verseEnglish: And when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers.

verseArabic: هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ
verseEnglish: He forms you in the wombs however He wills.
Then We bring you out as a child.
And We gave him judgment while yet a boy.
To give you a pure boy.

verseArabic: سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ
verseEnglish: We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham.

verseArabic: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا
verseEnglish: And when Joseph reached maturity, We gave him judgment and knowledge.
Indeed he has a father who is an old man.
An old woman, barren!
Greediest of people for life.
Every soul will taste death.
Then decreed a term.
And when the graves are scattered.

verseArabic: وَمِن وَرَائِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verseEnglish: And behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
When Joseph said to his father.

verseArabic: إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ الْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَا أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا
verseEnglish: Whether one or both of them reach old age with you.
And to parents, good treatment.
And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs.
And Mary, the daughter of 'Imran.
He said, 'Indeed, I am your brother.'

verseArabic: وَلَهُ أُخْتٌ فَلَهَا نِصْفُ مَا تَرَكَ
verseEnglish: And he has a sister, for her is half of what he left.
Dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise.
From the People of the Scripture.
And from our descendants a Muslim nation for You.
Are signs for a people who use reason.
And thus we have made you a just community.
And made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another.
And made you nations and tribes that you may know one another.
When he said to his companion, 'Do not grieve.'
Allah is the ally of those who believe.
Go down, some of you as enemies to one another.
But Satan caused them to slip out of it.
Except Iblees; he refused and was arrogant.
And they have made the jinn partners to Allah.
And when your Lord said to the angels.

verseArabic: مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّجِبْرِيلَ فَإِنَّهُ نَزَّلَهُ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ
verseEnglish: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is he who brought the Quran down upon your heart.
Seek help through patience and prayer.
If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.
Fear Allah and be with those who are true.
Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct.
Be persistently standing firm for Allah, witnesses in justice.
My mercy encompasses all things.
And to forego is nearer to righteousness.
While Allah promises you forgiveness from Him.

verseArabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
verseEnglish: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.
Indeed, we offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth.

verseArabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَوْفُوا بِالْعُقُودِ
verseEnglish: O you who have believed, fulfill all contracts.

verseArabic: وَأَوْفُوا بِالْعَهْدِ إِنَّ الْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْئُولًا
verseEnglish: And fulfill every commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever inquired about.
And when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel.
Righteousness is not that you turn your faces.
So race to all that is good.
Enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong.
Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good.
And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy.

verseArabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا
verseEnglish: And if you should count the favor of Allah, you could not enumerate it.
We would have opened upon them blessings from the sky.

verseArabic: هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verseEnglish: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers.
Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.
Did We not expand for you your breast?
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
Unquestionably, the help of Allah is near.
When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest.
When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest.
It increased them in faith, and they said, 'Sufficient for us is Allah.'

verseArabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا
verseEnglish: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet.
Then one of the two women came to him walking with shyness.
And let those who find not the means for marriage abstain.
He has succeeded who purifies it.
Certainly will the believers have succeeded.
Why do I invite you to salvation?
And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise.
They will have their reward with their Lord.
What has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous?

verseArabic: وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ
verseEnglish: And prefer them over themselves, even though they are in privation.
The believers are but brothers.
So make settlement between your brothers.
And cooperate in righteousness and piety.
Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allah].
So overlook [their faults] with gracious forgiveness.
And who restrain anger and who pardon the people.

verseArabic: قَالُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِي أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verseEnglish: They will say, 'Indeed, we were previously among our families fearful of Allah.'

verseArabic: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ
verseEnglish: It was by the mercy of Allah that you were lenient with them.
Those who walk on the earth easily.

verseArabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
verseEnglish: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur?
Do you perceive of them anyone?
We have made you a median community.
Those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course.
And act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.

verseArabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي النُّهَىٰ
verseEnglish: Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
I will guide you to the way of right conduct.
I convey to you the messages of my Lord and advise you.
And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him.
And stand before Allah, devoutly obedient.
When Allah is mentioned, their hearts become fearful.
So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord.
And forgive you your sins.
Yes, whoever earns evil.
Say, 'In them is great sin.'
Indeed, association with Him is great injustice.
And whoever exchanges faith for disbelief.
Are strongest in disbelief and hypocrisy.
There is to be no sexual relations, no wickedness.
And inspired it to its wickedness and its piety.

verseArabic: إِذْ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ أَنَّ الْقُوَّةَ لِلَّهِ
verseEnglish: When those who were wronged see the punishment.
And He forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression.
You assist one another against them in sin and aggression.
There is not in their breasts except pride.
When your great number pleased you.
Let not the worldly life deceive you.
And prevented the soul from unlawful inclination.
And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
Those who withhold what Allah has given them.
And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul.
And eat and drink, but be not excessive.
And do not spend wastefully.
Because they used to lie.
Exalted are You! This is a great slander.
And do not backbite each other.
A scorner, going about with malicious gossip.
Woe to every scorner and mocker.
Woe to every scorner and mocker.
Let not a people ridicule [another] people.
He only orders you to evil and immorality.
And forbidding what is wrong.
And Allah has permitted trade and has forbidden interest.
Listening to falsehood, consumers of what is unlawful.
Intoxicants, gambling, [sacrificing on] stone alters are an abomination.
Intoxicants, gambling are defilement.
They ask you about wine and gambling.
Stone alters and divining arrows.
Alters and divining arrows are defilement.
Teaching people magic.
Defilement from the work of Satan.
So We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky.
Fight them until there is no persecution.
And We will surely test you with something of fear.
Who, when disaster strikes them, say, 'Indeed we belong to Allah.'
With something of fear and hunger.
With something of fear and hunger.
And loss of wealth and lives.
And if Allah should touch you with adversity.
And [patient] in poverty and hardship.
In poverty and hardship and during battle.
Who spend in ease and in hardship.

verseArabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ
verseEnglish: Praise to Allah, who has removed from us all sorrow.
And We delivered him from the distress.
And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
Your breast is constrained by what they say.

verseArabic: وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ
verseEnglish: And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?

verseArabic: إِنَّهُ لَا يَيْأَسُ مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
verseEnglish: Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people.

verseArabic: اقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ
verseEnglish: Approached for people is their inspection, while they are in heedlessness.
Those who are heedless of their prayer.
The life of this world is but play and diversion.
The life of this world is but play and diversion.
Wealth and children are the adornment of worldly life.
And when your Lord said to the angels.
And he became of the disbelievers.

verseArabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ آمِنُوا كَمَا آمَنَ النَّاسُ
verseEnglish: And when it is said to them, 'Believe as the people have believed.'
And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds.
He who made for you the earth a bed.
Recite in the name of your Lord who created.
And who believe in what has been revealed to you.
Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
Guide us to the straight path.

meaning: He left to stray / led astray
verseArabic: يُضِلُّ بِهِ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِي بِهِ كَثِيرًا
verseEnglish: He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby.
I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.
It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
And when My servants ask you concerning Me.

verseArabic: لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَا
verseEnglish: We have no knowledge except what You have taught us.

verseArabic: شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
verseEnglish: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him.
And they say, 'We hear and we obey.'
Obey Allah and obey the Messenger.
And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.

verseArabic: فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
verseEnglish: And He turned to him. Indeed, He is the Accepting of repentance.

verseArabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُ
verseEnglish: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me, and He forgave him.

verseArabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
verseEnglish: And if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

verseArabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا
verseEnglish: O you who have believed, persevere and endure.
So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me.
So remember Me; I will remember you.

verseArabic: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
verseEnglish: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah.
Prostrate before Adam; so they prostrated.
And bow with those who bow.

meaning: He stood up for prayer / rose
verseEnglish: Stand [to pray] through the night, except a little.
And establish prayer and give zakah.
And establish prayer and give zakah.
And spend out of what We have provided for them.
And spend out of what We have provided for them.
Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them.
And thus be among the wrongdoers.
So he rebelled against the command of his Lord.

meaning: He denied the truth, called a lie
verseArabic: قَالُوا بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا
verseEnglish: They will say, 'Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied.'
You have fulfilled the vision.
And Allah had already given you victory at Badr.

verseArabic: وَإِن يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَن ذَا الَّذِي يَنصُرُكُم
verseEnglish: And if He should forsake you, who is there that can aid you?

verseArabic: كَم مِّن فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةً
verseEnglish: How many a small company has overcome a large company?
So if he was to die or be killed, would you turn back?
My Lord is the one who gives life and causes death.
My Lord is the one who gives life and causes death.

meaning: He raised up from the dead
verseEnglish: Then Allah sent the prophets as bringers of good tidings.
Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
So judge between them by what Allah has revealed.

verseArabic: وَإِذَا قَضَىٰ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verseEnglish: When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is.

verseArabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تَذْبَحُوا بَقَرَةً
verseEnglish: Indeed, Allah commands you to slaughter a cow.
And forbids immorality and bad conduct.
Allah has promised the believing men and believing women gardens.
And of Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations].
Hold firmly to what We have given you.
And left them in darkness so they could not see.

verseArabic: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِي بِبَكَّةَ
verseEnglish: Indeed, the first House established for mankind was that at Bakkah.
And raised high for you your repute.

verseArabic: وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ
verseEnglish: And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy.
Indeed, We have given you a clear conquest.
And she closed the doors and said, 'Come, you.'

verseArabic: وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
verseEnglish: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes.

verseArabic: وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ
verseEnglish: And from wherever you go out, turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram.
Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them.
That they will have gardens.
As if it were a brilliant star.

verseArabic: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْمُفْسِدُونَ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
verseEnglish: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.
Oh, I wish that I were dust!

verseArabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
verseEnglish: O mankind, worship your Lord so that you may become righteous.
And when your Lord said to the angels.
When the victory of Allah has come.

verseArabic: ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verseEnglish: Then He causes you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life.
Until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you.

meaning: Nay! By no means! Certainly not!
verseEnglish: No! You are going to know.
Yes, whoever earns evil.

verseArabic: فَهَلْ وَجَدتُّم مَّا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا قَالُوا نَعَمْ
verseEnglish: Have you found what your Lord promised you to be true? They will say, 'Yes.'
No doubt therein.

verseArabic: لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
verseEnglish: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.
And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham?
They ask you what they should spend.

verseArabic: يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ فِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ
verseEnglish: O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Abraham?

verseArabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
verseEnglish: Do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
Man will say on that Day, 'Where is the escape?'
When is the help of Allah?

verseArabic: كَم مِّن فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةً
verseEnglish: How many a small company has overcome a large company?
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming Event?

verseArabic: سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ
verseEnglish: It is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them.

verseArabic: قَالُوا هَٰذَا الَّذِي رُزِقْنَا مِن قَبْلُ
verseEnglish: They will say, 'This is what we were provided with before.'

verseArabic: الَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللَّهِ مِن بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ
verseEnglish: Who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it.
Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

meaning: With, Near, In the presence of
verseEnglish: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam.
When the hearts are at the throats, restrained.
And We raised over you the mount.
Gardens beneath which rivers flow.

verseArabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ
verseEnglish: He knows what is before them and what is behind them.
What is before them and what is behind them.
Rather, man desires to continue in sin ahead of him.

And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

And call your witnesses other than Allah.
In an equitable place.
Not of those who have evoked [Your] anger.
There is no deity except Him.

Do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part?

verseArabic: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا
verseEnglish: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth.

verseArabic: يُضِلُّ بِهِ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِي بِهِ كَثِيرًا
verseEnglish: He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby.

verseArabic: كَم مِّن فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةً
verseEnglish: How many a small company has overcome a large company?
Owner of Majesty and Honor.
And Allah is swift in account.
And indeed, among you is he who lingers behind.
Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
Those who had wished for his position yesterday.
And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow.
Now you have brought the truth.
And they will never wish for it, ever.

verseArabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى الْإِنسَانِ حِينٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ
verseEnglish: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time?

verseArabic: حِينٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْئًا مَّذْكُورًا
verseEnglish: A period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

verseArabic: إِن جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ اللَّيْلَ سَرْمَدًا
verseEnglish: If Allah should make for you the night continuous.
Who are killed in the cause of Allah are dead.

verseArabic: لَمْ يَكُنِ اللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ وَلَا لِيَهْدِيَهُمْ طَرِيقًا
verseEnglish: Allah will not forgive them, nor will He guide them to a path.
